# uptimeify_im_org_settings (Resource)

Incident Management settings of the token's organization (one per organization). Creating it adopts the existing settings and applies the configured values; destroying it only removes it from the state, the settings stay. Import with any id, e.g. `org`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One per organization; destroy only removes it from the state.
resource "uptimeify_im_org_settings" "this" {
  monitoring_bridge   = "both"
  overage_enabled     = false
  fallback_channel_id = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fallback_channel_id` (Number) Active Incident Management channel paged when an escalation runs out. Unset clears it.
- `monitoring_bridge` (String) Where classic monitoring alerts go: `im_only`, `classic_only` or `both`. Unset = keep the current value.
- `overage_enabled` (Boolean) Allow Incident Management usage beyond the plan (billed as overage). Unset = keep the current value.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Incident Management is active (`POST /api/im/activate`; read only here).
- `id` (String) The organization id.
- `organization_id` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Any id works: the settings belong to the token's organization.
terraform import uptimeify_im_org_settings.this org
```
